article.story: ALBANY, N.Y. -- — AJ Lesburt Jr. scored 25 points to help Merrimack defeat Albany 73-60 on Sunday. Lesburt added three steals for the Warriors (1-2). Ayden Johnson shot 4 for 7 (2 for 4 from 3-point range) and 3 of 4 from the free-throw line to add 13 points. Denver Anglin scored 11. Ollie Engen finished with 17 points for the Great Danes (2-1). U-Mier Graham added 16 points and eight rebounds, while Tyler Jones finished with 13 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
